verdict.rationale: Crossmint's own API reference documents an interactive console: the reference pages let you "call the APIs directly from the browser" and "test them live from the browser". Per-endpoint reference pages exist for onramp and offramp orders and payment methods. The openapi probe returning 404 only shows no public spec at those paths; it does not contradict the in-browser try-it capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the live console works, and documented detail on per-endpoint runnable code samples (language snippets, sandbox keys).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
